purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: MINDCAF’s official document page publishes the decree assigning departmental cadastral services responsibility for cadastral plans/registers, extracts, map updates and boundary demarcation. The official MINHDU contact page locates regional urban-planning offices in Maroua; MINHDU is not treated as the land registry. The official material reviewed did not expose an anonymous public parcel map/vector API or WUP-point feature.
registryAssessment: MINDCAF’s official decree assigns cadastral-plan and register custody to departmental cadastral services; the official contact page confirms the Maroua locality but MINHDU is kept distinct from cadastre custody.
